description.en: The description of the data source.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.
></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 数据源名称，支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度为1~30个字符，一个中文及日文占2个字符。
description.en: Datasource Name. It can contain Chinese characters, English letters, Japanese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The length must be 1 to 30 characters. Each Chinese or Japanese character occupies 2 characters.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API is 10 per Alibaba Cloud account.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot create-parser-data-source --iot-instance-id iot-w20000 --name DataSource --description '设备数据。' --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot CreateParserDataSource --region cn-hangzhou --Description '设备数据。' --IotInstanceId 'iot-w20000' --Name DataSource
